free_tier.stated: Per-GB-month, 5 GB free (Standard); tiers Standard / Infrequent Access / Archive Instant Retrieval / Archive

egress.terms: Free on every tier, verbatim: "Egress | Free" across all four tiers, and "Data Transfer (Egress) is always free" / "no charge for Data Transfer (Egress)". No ratio, no fair-use clause in the pricing text.

tooling: All S3 SDKs, rclone, bucket forking, lifecycle rules, soft deletes
chaining: S3 origin with genuinely zero egress cost — the cleanest pairing with a Cloudflare front end because there is no allowance to police.

limits.value: delete or transition earlier and the full 30 days

limits_note: `retention-clamped` on the cheap tiers: Infrequent Access and Archive tiers carry a minimum storage duration (30 days for IA) — delete or transition earlier and the full 30 days is still billed. Data retrieval is charged on IA ($0.01/GB) and Archive Instant Retrieval ($0.03/GB); Archive tier has no retrieval charge. Storage measured in binary GB (2^30).
reliability_note: Newer vendor; free tier is only 5 GB so there is no meaningful free path, and the archive tier still bills a full 30-day minimum per object.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: rate table strings from raw HTML: $0.02/GB/month (Standard), $0.01/GB/month (IA), $0.004/GB/month (Archive Instant Retrieval), $0.004/GB/month (Archive); retrieval $0.01/GB (IA), $0.03/GB (Archive IR), Free (Standard/Archive); "Egress Free" on all tiers
"A minimum storage retention charge applies to objects stored in the Infrequent Access, Archive, and Archive Instant Retrieval tiers... 30-day storage charge will still apply"
Tigris included in normalized comparison, checked 17 Oct 2026

price_per_tb_month: Standard $20.00/TB at 5 TB and 20 TB. Archive $4.00/TB at 20 TB ($80/mo) with free egress and free retrieval — the best cold tier after OVH Cold Archive.
notes: Per-GB-month, 5 GB free (Standard); tiers Standard / Infrequent Access / Archive Instant Retrieval / Archive
